casual.title: ☕ 1. Starbucks Special Requests & Coffee Customization
casual.subtitle: 星巴克与精品咖啡特调定制（母语者级）

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like an iced oat milk latte with two pumps of sugar-free vanilla syrup, please.
sentences.cn: 嗨，请给我来一杯冰燕麦奶拿铁，加两泵无糖香草糖浆。
sentences.ipa: /haɪ, aɪd laɪk ən aɪst oʊt mɪlk ˈlɑːteɪ wɪð tuː pʌmps əv ˈʃʊɡər friː vəˈnɪlə ˈsɪrəp, pliːz/

sentences.en: Could you make it light ice and add a cold foam on top?
sentences.cn: 可以做成少冰，并且在上面加一层冷奶泡吗？
sentences.ipa: /kʊd juː meɪk ɪt laɪt aɪs ænd æd ə koʊld foʊm ɑːn tɑːp/

sentences.en: Sure! Would you like an extra shot of espresso to make it stronger?
sentences.cn: 没问题！您需要额外加个浓缩浓缩萃取意式浓缩让口感更浓郁吗？
sentences.ipa: /ʃʊr! wʊd juː laɪk ən ˈekstrə ʃɑːt əv eˈspresoʊ tuː meɪk ɪt ˈstrɔːŋɡər/

sentences.en: That would be awesome. Please put it under the name Alex.
sentences.cn: 那太棒了。杯子上请写名字 Alex，谢谢。
sentences.ipa: /ðæt wʊd biː ˈɔːsəm. pliːz pʊt ɪt ˈʌndər ðə neɪm ˈælɪks/

casual.title: 🍔 2. Drive-Thru Ordering & Secret Menu
casual.subtitle: 美式得来速与隐藏菜单点餐

sentences.en: Welcome to In-N-Out! What can I get started for you today?
sentences.cn: 欢迎来到 In-N-Out！今天为您点些什么？
sentences.ipa: /ˈwelkəm tuː ɪn ænd aʊt! wʌt kæn aɪ ɡet ˈstɑːrtɪd fɔːr juː təˈdeɪ/

sentences.en: Can I get a Double-Double animal style, with well-done fries?
sentences.cn: 请给我一份双层牛肉芝士汉堡主厨秘制款（Animal Style），薯条要炸到特别酥脆的。
sentences.ipa: /kæn aɪ ɡet ə ˈdʌbl ˈdʌbl ˈænɪml staɪl, wɪð wel dʌn fraɪz/

sentences.en: Got it! Anything to drink with your combo meal?
sentences.cn: 收到！您的套餐需要搭配什么饮料吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɡɑːt ɪt! ˈeniθɪŋ tuː drɪŋk wɪð jʊər ˈkɑːmboʊ miːl/

sentences.en: I'll take a chocolate milkshake. Please pull up to the second window.
sentences.cn: 我要一杯巧克力奶昔。请把车开到第二个窗口结账取餐。
sentences.ipa: /aɪl teɪk ə ˈtʃɑːklət ˈmɪlkʃeɪk. pliːz pʊl ʌp tuː ðə ˈsekənd ˈwɪndoʊ/

casual.title: 🍻 3. Happy Hour at a Bar & Socializing
casual.subtitle: 美式酒吧 Happy Hour 点酒与社交破冰

sentences.en: Hey guys! Is this seat taken, or mind if I join you?
sentences.cn: 嗨伙计们！这个位置有人吗，介意我和你们坐一起吗？
sentences.ipa: /heɪ ɡaɪz! ɪz ðɪs siːt ˈteɪkən, ɔːr maɪnd ɪf aɪ dʒɔɪn juː/

sentences.en: Not at all, grab a chair! We're just celebrating Friday night.
sentences.cn: 完全不介意，快拉把椅子坐！我们正在庆祝周五夜生活呢。
sentences.ipa: /nɑːt æt ɔːl, ɡræb ə tʃer! wiːr dʒʌst ˈselɪbreɪtɪŋ ˈfraɪdeɪ naɪt/

sentences.en: Bartender, I'll have an Old Fashioned on the rocks, please.
sentences.cn: 调酒师，请给我一杯古典鸡尾酒（Old Fashioned），加冰块。
sentences.ipa: /ˈbɑːrtendər, aɪl hæv ən oʊld ˈfæʃnd ɑːn ðə rɑːks, pliːz/

sentences.en: Cheers to a great weekend ahead!
sentences.cn: 为接下来美好的周末干杯！
sentences.ipa: /tʃɪərz tuː ə ɡreɪt ˈwiːkend əˈhed/

casual.title: 🏠 4. House Hunting & Apartment Lease Agreement
casual.subtitle: 美式租房看房与签署 Lease 协议

sentences.en: Hi, I'm calling about the two-bedroom apartment listed on Zillow.
sentences.cn: 你好，我是打电话咨询 Zillow 上挂牌的那套两居室公寓的。
sentences.ipa: /haɪ, aɪm ˈkɔːlɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə tuː ˈbedruːm əˈpɑːrtmənt ˈlɪstɪd ɑːn Zillow/

sentences.en: Is the unit fully furnished, and are utilities included in the monthly rent?
sentences.cn: 请问这套房子带有全套家具吗？水电气网杂费包含在月租金里吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɪz ðə ˈjuːnɪt ˈfʊli ˈfɜːrnɪʃt, ænd ɑːr juːˈtɪlətiz ɪnˈkluːdɪd ɪn ðə ˈmʌnθli rent/

sentences.en: It comes with in-unit washer and dryer. Security deposit is one month rent.
sentences.cn: 室内自带洗衣机和烘干机。押金为一个月房租。
sentences.ipa: /ɪt kʌmz wɪð ɪn ˈjuːnɪt ˈwɑːʃər ænd ˈdraɪər. sɪˈkjʊrəti dɪˈpɑːzɪt ɪz wʌn mʌnθ rent/

casual.title: 🍕 5. Ordering Pizza & Splitting the Bill via Venmo
casual.subtitle: 美式聚会点披萨与 Venmo 割账分摊

sentences.en: Let's order two large pepperoni and mushroom pizzas for the game night.
sentences.cn: 球赛之夜我们来点两份大号意大利香肠蘑菇披萨吧。
sentences.ipa: /lets ˈɔːrdər tuː lɑːrdʒ ˌpepəˈroʊni ænd ˈmʌʃruːm ˈpiːtsəz fɔːr ðə ɡeɪm naɪt/

sentences.en: Sounds great! Just Venmo me your share once the food arrives.
sentences.cn: 听起来不错！等外卖一送达，直接用 Venmo 把你那份钱转给我就行。
sentences.ipa: /saʊndz ɡreɪt! dʒʌst Venmo miː jʊər ʃer wʌns ðə fuːd əˈraɪvz/

workplace.title: 💼 1. Elevator Pitch & Networking Event
workplace.subtitle: 硅谷高管级 30 秒电梯演讲与 Networking 社交

sentences.en: Hi! I'm Alex, leveraging generative AI to automate enterprise workflow automation.
sentences.cn: 你好！我是 Alex，目前正在利用生成式 AI 自动化赋能企业工作流。
sentences.ipa: /haɪ! aɪm ˈælɪks, ˈlevərɪdʒɪŋ ˈdʒenərətɪv AI tuː ˈɔːtəmeɪt ˈentərpraɪz ˈwɜːrkfloʊ/

sentences.en: We've reduced customer onboarding time by over sixty percent quarter-over-quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们成功将客户入职体验流程耗时环比降低了 60% 以上。
sentences.ipa: /wiːv rɪˈduːst ˈkʌstəmər ˈɑːnboʊrdɪŋ taɪm baɪ ˈoʊvər ˈsɪksti pərˈsent/

sentences.en: That is incredible traction! Let me grab your LinkedIn to stay connected.
sentences.cn: 那业务增长势头太惊人了！加个 LinkedIn 保持联系吧。
sentences.ipa: /ðæt ɪz ɪnˈkredəbl ˈtrækʃn! let miː ɡræb jʊər LinkedIn tuː steɪ kəˈnektɪd/

workplace.title: 📊 2. Product Sprint Planning & Daily Standup
workplace.subtitle: 科技公司敏捷开发、Sprint 站会与需求确认

sentences.en: Good morning team! Let's kick off our daily standup meeting.
sentences.cn: 大家早上好！我们开始今天的每日敏捷站会吧。
sentences.ipa: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ tiːm! lets kɪk ɔːf aʊər ˈdeɪli ˈstændʌp ˈmiːtɪŋ/

sentences.en: Yesterday I refactored the API authentication module. No blockers on my end.
sentences.cn: 昨天我重构了 API 鉴权模块。我这边目前没有任何阻碍卡点。
sentences.ipa: /ˈjestərdeɪ aɪ riːˈfæktərd ðə API ɔːˌθentɪˈkeɪʃn ˈmɑːdjuːl. noʊ ˈblɑːkərz ɑːn maɪ end/

sentences.en: Great! Let's ensure high test coverage before pushing to production.
sentences.cn: 太棒了！推上线前请确保有高比例的测试覆盖率。
sentences.ipa: /ɡreɪt! lets ɪnˈʃʊr haɪ test ˈkʌvərɪdʒ bɪˈfɔːr ˈpʊʃɪŋ tuː prəˈdʌkʃn/

workplace.title: 🔥 3. Salary Negotiation & Offer Counter
workplace.subtitle: 硅谷高薪 Offer 谈判与 Counteroffer 争论

sentences.en: Thank you for extending the job offer. I'm really thrilled about this team.
sentences.cn: 感谢贵公司发放该职位 Offer。我对加入该团队感到非常激动。
sentences.ipa: /θæŋk juː fɔːr ɪkˈstendɪŋ ðə dʒɑːb ˈɔːfər. aɪm ˈriːəli θrɪld əˈbaʊt ðɪs tiːm/

sentences.en: Based on my market value and competing offers, can we discuss stock equity compensation?
sentences.cn: 基于我的市场价值以及手头的竞争 Offer，我们能探讨下股票期权回报吗？
sentences.ipa: /beɪst ɑːn maɪ ˈmɑːrkɪt ˈvæljuː, kæn wiː dɪˈskʌs stɑːk ˈekwəti ˌkɑːmpenˈseɪʃn/

sentences.en: We can bump up your signing bonus by twenty percent to bridge the gap.
sentences.cn: 我们可以将您的签字费额外提升 20%，来弥补这部分的预期差距。
sentences.ipa: /wiː kæn bʌmp ʌp jʊər ˈsaɪnɪŋ ˈboʊnəs baɪ ˈtwenti pərˈsent tuː brɪdʒ ðə ɡæp/

workplace.title: 🧠 4. Brainstorming & Elegant Objections
workplace.subtitle: 高情商头脑风暴与优雅化解团队分歧

sentences.en: I completely see where you're coming from, but have we considered scalability?
sentences.cn: 我完全理解你的立足点与初衷，但我们是否有考虑到长期的架构扩展性呢？
sentences.ipa: /aɪ kəmˈpliːtli siː wer jʊər ˈkʌmɪŋ frʌm, bʌt hæv wiː kənˈsɪdərd ˌskeɪləˈbɪləti/

vocab.cn: 理解你的立场与出发点

sentences.en: That's a valid point. Let's run a quick A/B test to validate user feedback.
sentences.cn: 这是个很有说服力的要点。我们来做个快速 A/B 测试来验证用户反馈吧。
sentences.ipa: /ðæts ə ˈvælɪd pɔɪnt. lets rʌn ə kwɪk A/B test tuː ˈvælɪdeɪt ˈjuːzər ˈfiːdbæk/

travel.title: ✈️ 1. Flight Delay & Rebooking at Airport Desk
travel.subtitle: 美式机场航班延误拉扯与免费改签

sentences.en: My connecting flight to San Francisco was cancelled due to severe thunderstorm.
sentences.cn: 我飞往旧金山的转机航班因强雷暴天气被不幸取消了。
sentences.ipa: /maɪ kəˈnektɪŋ flaɪt tuː sæn frənˈsɪskoʊ wəz ˈkænsld duː tuː sɪˈvɪər ˈθʌndərstɔːrm/

sentences.en: I can rebook you on the next available direct flight at no extra charge.
sentences.cn: 我可以免费帮您改签到下一班有空位的直飞航班。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ kæn riːˈbʊk juː ɑːn ðə nekst əˈveɪləbl dəˈrekt flaɪt æt noʊ ˈekstrə tʃɑːrdʒ/

sentences.en: Could you also provide me with a meal voucher and hotel accommodation?
sentences.cn: 您还能为我提供一张餐券以及今晚的酒店住宿安排吗？
sentences.ipa: /kʊd juː ˈɔːlsoʊ prəˈvaɪd miː wɪð ə miːl ˈvaʊtʃər ænd hoʊˈtel əˌkɑːməˈdeɪʃn/

travel.subtitle: Hertz 海外租车、车型升级与全险选择

sentences.en: I reserved a full-size SUV for a one-week California road trip.
sentences.cn: 我预订了一辆全尺寸 SUV，准备去加州自驾游玩一周。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ rɪˈzɜːrvd ə fʊl saɪz SUV fɔːr ə wʌn wiːk road trip/

sentences.en: Would you like to add full collision damage waiver coverage for peace of mind?
sentences.cn: 为了出行安心，您是否需要添加全额碰撞险（CDW）保障？
sentences.ipa: /wʊd juː laɪk tuː æd fʊl kəˈlɪʒn ˈdæmɪdʒ ˈweɪvər ˈkʌvərɪdʒ fɔːr piːs əv maɪnd/

travel.subtitle: 海外紧急看病 Urgent Care 与医生求助

sentences.en: Doctor, I have a severe throbbing headache and high fever since last night.
sentences.cn: 医生，我从昨晚起就一直剧烈偏头痛并伴有高烧。
sentences.ipa: /ˈdɑːktər, aɪ hæv ə sɪˈvɪər ˈθrɑːbɪŋ ˈhedeɪk ænd haɪ ˈfiːvər sɪns læst naɪt/

sentences.en: Let me take your blood pressure and prescribe some antibiotics for you.
sentences.cn: 让我量一下您的血压，并为您开一些抗生素药物。
sentences.ipa: /let miː teɪk jʊər blʌd ˈpreʃər ænd prɪˈskraɪb sʌm ˌæntibaɪˈɑːtɪks fɔːr juː/

sentences.cn: 这杯冰咖啡在炎热的夏天下午喝起来简直太解爽/到位了！

sentences.cn: 关于上线的时间表，我们大家的步调和理解都一致吗？

sentences.cn: 绝不吹牛/真没骗你，这款 AI 工具对开发者而言绝对是颠覆性的神器！
